DF 53.16 native PE cancellation announcement text constructors

Input images are the reference and classic paths in
data/runtime/native-pe-images.json. They are read from disk; no game process,
desktop, announcement renderer, or translation interpreter is executed.
native-functions.tsv preserves PE identity and actual unwind boundaries.
Annotated *.asm, native-literals.tsv, switch-branches.tsv and
decompiled-job-fields.tsv retain source operands and native branch decisions.

Cancellation constructor:
  Reference 0x141325080..0x141328443
  Classic   0x14131fff0..0x1413233b3

Relevant source-equivalent text construction:
  text = unit_identity(current_unit)
  text += " cancels "
  text += job_caption(current_unit.current_job)
  text += ": "
  switch(cancel_reason.code) { // complete selector range 0..135
    fixed_reason:
      text += selector_literal
    interrupted:
      text += "Interrupted by "
      if(cancel_reason.interruptor_id != -1 && unit_exists(id))
        text += unit_identity(interruptor)
      else
        text += "combat"
    needs_item_or_linked_stockpile:
      requirement = copy_all_job_item_constraints(cancel_reason)
      text += "Needs "
      text += describe_job_item(requirement, cancel_reason.quantity)
      if(cancel_reason.code == 135) text += " in linked stockpile"
    job_item_missing:
      text += job_wording_flag ? "Job item misplaced"
                              : "Job item lost or destroyed"
    out_of_range:
      // No reason text is appended.
  }
  text += "."
  submit_announcement(text, current_unit_or_building_location)

decompiled-reason-switch.tsv contains every reason selector, including aliases
and both dynamic branches. announcement-cancellation-grammar.tsv gives the
complete sentence productions and preserves every typed actor, job,
interruptor and requirement field. It also retains the native out-of-range
output with no reason. The announcement visibility/suppression branches occur
before string construction and do not provide additional displayed reasons.

Job wrapper:
  Reference 0x140d03170..0x140d0329b
  Classic   0x140d001b0..0x140d002db
  Surgery job 169 selects Surgery, Stop Bleeding, Repair Compound Fracture or
  Remove Rotten Tissue by surgical sub-operation. Every other job calls the
  job-type dispatcher with material, item subtype, subject, reaction and flags.

Job dispatcher:
  Reference 0x140d032b0..0x140d082d4
  Classic   0x140d002f0..0x140d05314
  Main selector range is 0..247. decompiled-job-fields.tsv walks every native
  reachable branch from each selector, recording all textual operands,
  dynamic field-supplying calls and decisions, including shared tails.

The dynamic construction families are:
  Make/Forge/Assemble + quantity word + size + material + complete item subtype.
  Native quantity words are three, four, five, twenty-five and pair of.
  Native material tests also select portal/door, throne/chair, coffin/casket/
  sarcophagus, coffer/box/chest, vial/flask/waterskin, cup/goblet/mug,
  cage/terrarium, chain/rope, tube/pipe section and Make/Forge wording.
  Mill/Process/Extract from + complete plant name, including vial/barrel.
  Cut/Polish/Smelt/Mint/Decorate with/Stud with + material or resource subject.
  Encrust + selected finished-goods/furniture/ammo target + material.
  Dye/Tint + complete thread/cloth/leather material + color/dye.
  Mix + complete material + material + dye input.
  Bait trap with + native fish/meat/gem selection and optional material.
  Milk/Shear/Geld/Slaughter/Tame/Chain/Release/Handle/Cage/Pit-pond/
  Pen-pasture/Train/Interrogate + actual unit or species subject.
  Train may append " to hunt" or " for war".
  Sew + native material + image.
  Reaction selector 209 finds the reaction by its code, copies reaction.name
  and capitalizes its first letter; absent reaction is the fixed "Reaction".
  RAW reaction NAME inputs from both configured editions are recorded in
  native-literals.tsv and translated as complete scoped activity fields.
  Generated instrument reactions remain complete named instrument or piece
  jobs and use the established instrument-name parser.

Two additional explicit native identity productions use fortress-job grammar:
  Selector 155 at reference 0x140d04007 adds "Unchain" and, only when the
  target reference resolves, a space plus its complete native unit identity.
  Missing target leaves the fixed Unchain caption.
  Selector 211 at reference 0x140d0473a finds a memorial record. A stored name
  calls 0x140a94030; otherwise a live unit calls 0x141330c30; otherwise the
  stored race/caste calls 0x140aa3bd0. All three successful subjects append
  " (engrave memorial)". Missing record uses Engrave memorial slab.
  The private memorial-subject scope therefore resolves the full native
  unit/name/species label. Authored names remain intact inside the known job.

announcement-job-fields.tsv contains complete finite native captions and
installed reaction names. The plural "Brew drink from plants" is specifically
attested by the user's supplied screenshot. It is retained alongside the
current RAW singular plant and fruit names; no unobserved plural fruit variant
is introduced. This is a field alias, never a global word replacement.

Job-item requirement constructor:
  Reference 0x140a2adb0..0x140a2c60c
  Classic   0x140a285e0..0x140a29e3c
  Independent constraints are appended in native order, rather than choosing
  one mutually exclusive English adjective. decompiled-requirement-prefixes.tsv
  records every append and its preceding native condition in both editions.
  Flags cover state, material, category, containment, reaction class/product,
  tool use, color, improvement/artifact restrictions, quantity and excluded bin.
  The terminal shared item formatter is reference 0x140a82c10..0x140a882fc
  and classic 0x140a7fc90..0x140a8537c. Its full noun, material and number
  branches are also extracted, rather than treating the screenshot noun as
  one independent literal.

The screenshot requirement follows three independent native flags:
  [job_item+0x0c] & 0x400  => "empty " at 0x140a2affc
  [job_item+0x24] & 0x04  => "non-absorbent " at 0x140a2b630
  [job_item+0x24] & 0x80  => "food storage " at 0x140a2b64c
  shared fallback item noun => "item" at 0x140a88046
The established Workshop recipe grammar composes all three states with the
complete item, preserves displayed quantity, and excludes partial resolution.
Its scoped translations are shared with workshop cards and work conditions.

These files document extracted native source and authored translation grammar.
They are not simulated game output or evidence of the final displayed result.
